# artifactapi_github_app (Resource)

Manages a GitHub App credential that GitHub-facing remotes reference via `github_app` to authenticate with installation tokens. The server never returns the private key; the configured key is kept in state and compared by fingerprint on refresh, so a key changed outside Terraform is rewritten on the next apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# GitHub App credential; remotes reference it by name to authenticate with
# installation tokens instead of a static token in `password`.
resource "artifactapi_github_app" "acme" {
  name            = "acme"
  app_id          = 123456
  installation_id = 7654321
  private_key     = file("acme-app.private-key.pem")
  description     = "acme GitHub App"

  # Optional: GitHub Enterprise Server API root (default https://api.github.com).
  # api_base_url = "https://ghe.example.com/api/v3"
}

resource "artifactapi_remote_github_rpm" "acme_tools" {
  name            = "acme-tools"
  base_url        = "https://api.github.com/repos/acme/tools"
  releases_remote = "github"
  github_app      = artifactapi_github_app.acme.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (Number) GitHub App ID; must be positive.
- `installation_id` (Number) Installation ID of the app on the target account or organisation; must be positive.
- `name` (String) Unique name of the GitHub App credential.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) RSA private key of the app in PEM form (PKCS#1 or PKCS#8). Write-only on the server and stored in Terraform state; after import it is unknown, so the next apply rewrites it.

### Optional

- `api_base_url` (String) Absolute https URL of the GitHub API; the server defaults it to `https://api.github.com`. Set it for GitHub Enterprise Server; removing it from configuration keeps the current value.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp reported by the server.
- `private_key_fingerprint` (String) `SHA256:` plus the unpadded base64 SHA-256 of the DER PKIX public key.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp reported by the server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name. The private key is never returned by the server, so the
# next apply rewrites it from configuration.
terraform import artifactapi_github_app.acme acme
```
